case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You described the alloy surcharge and the labour side as the pressure on your calculation, and Option B answers that directly: with the index clause on the alloy surcharge, we carry the movement above the deadband, so the base price needs no risk premium.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.92; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you a longer contract term and a clear, fixed price, and the cost trends above do not call for a risk buffer. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you may need sign-off above you, I would ask you to take Option A to the person who decides. A short paragraph for that person: Option A gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal a fixed unit price, a contract term that secures its planning, and no exposure to index disputes. It can be approved as it stands. If your approval needs anything more from us, we will gladly provide it.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are prepared to build on your Option B, accepting the 24-month contract with the AS-14404 index clause and 60-day payment terms, at a revised unit price of €5.60. 

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. While we acknowledge the index movements you cited, our AS-14404 requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning these market decreases do not reduce our current cost basis.

Furthermore, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We must respectfully decline your request for a cost breakdown, as it is our policy not to disclose internal calculation details.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Because we carry the movement above the deadband, the base price no longer needs a risk premium. Since your alloy cover is fixed, you are not exposed to that movement at all.

On price history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.07; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.00; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 3 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.04; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you may need sign-off, here is a short paragraph for your pricing committee. Could you please take Option A to the person who decides? We are glad to provide anything else their approval needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Building on your Option C, we propose a revised unit price of €5.41, maintaining the 60-day payment terms and the 24-month contract with the AS-14404 index clause. 

Under this alternative, we set a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Otherwise, our main Angebot is a price of €5.37 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
